title: Mandate
description: Signed delegation, AP2-shaped Intent mandate [F12], not a full W3C VC: the delegator's plain-language intent_text plus compiled rules, one field per rule chip. Seal = the delegator signs it. Signature: Ed25519 by `delegator` over the UTF-8 bytes of 'laisee.mandate.v1:' + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of this object without `signature`. This file also holds the shared primitives ($defs) the other schemas reference. Encodings everywhere: money = integer HKD minor units (cents); time = RFC 3339 UTC with 'Z'; hashes = lowercase hex SHA-256; signatures and raw keys = base64url without padding.

delegator.description: Person who seals the packet. Signs this mandate, revokes and escalation answers.

agent.description: Agent identity this mandate authorises. The planner process holds no key and no card material (I4).

intent_text.description: Plain-language sentence typed by the delegator (DIR1). Display and judge context only; the engine reads `rules`.

MoneyMinor.description: Integer HKD minor units (cents). No floats anywhere in money.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC, 'Z' suffix, optional milliseconds. One format so canonical JSON hashes are stable.

DidKey.description: Ed25519 public key as did:key (multibase base58btc, multicodec 0xed01). If D9 cuts did:key, use 'ed25519:' + base64url of the 32-byte key; nothing else changes.

SignatureB64u.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes), base64url without padding.

Domain.description: Lowercase merchant host name, no scheme or path.

CompiledRules.description: One field per rule chip in the MandateEditor. Defaults for absent optional fields come from config, which cites the facts register.

expires_at.description: (R2) Mandate and packet end. No card TTL runs past it.

budget.description: (R3) Packet size. remaining = budget - committed - spent (see packet-state).

per_purchase.description: (R4) Optional. Effective cap = min over present terms of hard_cap_minor and floor(remaining_minor * share_of_remaining_bp / 10000). Total above ask_above_minor => ESCALATE. Absent => R4 SKIPPED and R3 binds (DM1).

share_of_remaining_bp.description: Adaptive cap in basis points of packet remaining.

categories.description: (R6) Every cart item category must be in this list.

merchants.description: (R6) allow = null means any domain; deny always wins.

seller_check.description: (R9) Scameter state FLAGGED always => DENY. require_capture = true: missing or stale capture => ESCALATE (unverified). 'No record' is not 'safe' [F6].

max_capture_age_s.description: Stale after this age. Default from config [F52].

velocity.description: (R7) Optional override of the default [F32]: more than max_mints approved mints within window_s => DENY.

ParentLink.description: Teen chain only (cut first, D9). Points at the parent-sealed mandate; caps compose: agent <= teen packet <= parent funding. mandate_sha256 = SHA-256 of JCS of the full signed parent mandate.

Revocation.description: Delegator-signed revoke (S4), payload of MANDATE_REVOKED. signer must equal mandate.delegator. Signature over UTF-8 of 'laisee.revoke.v1:' + hex SHA-256(JCS(this object without signature)).

$comment: examples[0] is SIMULATED: demo mandate M0 (DM1), HK$800 packet [F20], no per-purchase cap, so R3 binds. Keys, signature and dates are placeholders [F59].
